warmup: docker compose -p coolify -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f .homemade/compose.yaml build coolify testing-host coolify-helper
docker compose -p coolify -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f .homemade/compose.yaml pull --ignore-buildable
docker compose -p coolify -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f .homemade/compose.yaml run --rm --no-deps --pull never --entrypoint composer coolify install --no-interaction
docker compose -p coolify -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f .homemade/compose.yaml run --rm --no-deps --pull never --entrypoint npm vite ci
docker compose -p coolify -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f .homemade/compose.yaml run --rm --no-deps --pull never --entrypoint npm vite run build
sudo chown -R $USER: node_modules vendor storage bootstrap/cache public/build
install: docker compose -p coolify -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f .homemade/compose.yaml run --rm --no-deps --pull never --entrypoint composer coolify install --no-interaction

[ node_modules/.package-lock.json -nt package-lock.json ] || docker compose -p coolify -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f .homemade/compose.yaml run --rm --no-deps --pull never --entrypoint npm vite ci

web.cmd: exec docker compose -p coolify -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f .homemade/compose.yaml up --no-build --pull never coolify postgres redis vite testing-host mailpit minio

healthcheck.cmd: docker exec coolify-redis redis-cli ping | grep -q PONG
